subject: Re: Kickoff: COMISR for user-upload enhancement
body:
Hi Zofia,

Fractions: Tereza Aliyev leads at 40%, Leilani Nakamura 30% on the training/eval loop, Emeka Pinto 30% on the ffmpeg compression pipeline, Saoirse Eriksen 20% on serving prep through April. Jorge Vidal is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 — he owns the eval-and-deployment phase that runs past the May code-complete date, including the Shipyard demo and the post-LRB fixes.

Compute: titan-a100 best-effort, 16 GPUs; this is inference-heavy eval, no reservation.

Dependency: the vid4 test data and pretrained checkpoint come from our public release buckets; Emeka is mirroring them internally with checksums this week so eval is hermetic.

One flag: five people at small fractions is coordination-heavy. If anything slips I'd rather consolidate onto Tereza and Jorge than add people.

Bao
